kernel.governing_law: Surplus is the native element — abundance outruns need, and the speaker rides the excess until the whole economy of sense is spent on sound alone.
kernel.mutated_relation: Past the break-point, the sound-surplus devours its own referent — the chain no longer reports a world but generates the only world there is, and that world is the chain consuming itself.
